brief.headline: Cut laminate price from ₹1067.36/KG to ₹250/KG — close a 326.9% gap and save ₹58850 annually

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹250/KG on the LAMINATE SKU, matching the best price we pay to Silk Polypack
priceAsk.basis: We pay Silk Polypack ₹250.00/KG for the same item — a 326.9% gap. The open-market asking band for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg), so our Silk price sits at the fair market line. Huhtamaki's price is four times that benchmark.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep the current 30 days — no change needed

brief.financialLeverage: Huhtamaki is a ₹2755.75 Cr company that keeps about ₹4.70 of every ₹100 they sell and carries very little debt (0.11x). They're growing fast — 23.1% a year — so they want new orders. But we're tiny: our ₹76850 spend is 0.00% of their revenue, so on our own we have almost no pull. The play is to use the Silk Polypack benchmark and the threat of moving volume to UFLEX or Constantia Parikh (both credible laminate converters) to force them down to market rate.

evidence.point: We pay Huhtamaki ₹1067.36/KG; Silk Polypack charges ₹250.00/KG for the same LAMINATE SKU
Open-market asking band for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg, typical ₹250/kg — our Silk price is market-fair
Huhtamaki's sales are growing fast, so they want volume
We're a tiny customer — our spend is 0.00% of their ₹2755.75 Cr revenue
They keep about ₹4.70 of every ₹100 sold and carry very little debt

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant (₹17547.92 Cr) — both film substrate AND conversion; can second-source laminates at scale

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India converter (₹222.04 Cr) — pharma blister/sachet laminates; strong second-source option

alternates.name: Amcor Flexibles India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Amcor's India arm — high-end pharma laminates; premium but very reliable

risks: We're 0.00% of their business, so they may walk away — bundle this with other FDC laminate volume or commit a longer contract to get leverage
The 326.9% gap is so wide it suggests either a spec difference or a reseller margin baked into Huhtamaki's price — verify the Silk Polypack material matches exactly before pushing hard
Huhtamaki's health score is C (58/100) — not distressed but not top-tier; if we squeeze too hard on a tiny order they may just drop us
UFLEX and Constantia are credible alternates, but we haven't qualified or priced them yet — start those RFQs now so the threat is real in the room
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We've been paying you ₹1067 a kilo for LAMINATE, but we're getting the same thing from Silk Polypack at ₹250 — and that matches the open market rate — so we need you at ₹250 to keep this business.
